texte.Neuf articles au lieu de trente-deux. Le: Nine clauses instead of thirty-two. The first rate flatters you; the second tells you what you really have left to do.
texte.Neuf clauses, ou quinze. La différence s: Nine clauses, or fifteen. The difference turns on a single answer, and it changes the content of the negotiation.
texte.Neuf référentiels, neuf taux, et une que: Nine frameworks, nine rates, and one question: which to deal with first. This path starts from the summary, goes down to the plan, and ends with what the plan CANNOT do — it is this last step that makes the first two defensible in committee.

texte.Ni l'annexe I ni l'annexe II ne visent l: Neither Annex I nor Annex II targets educational institutions. But Annex II, point # names “research organisations”: a university’s research unit falls within it, its teaching activity does not. The boundary runs inside the institution.
texte.Ni l'annexe I ni l'annexe II. Le régime: Neither Annex I nor Annex II. The applicable regime is that of the AI Act in general, plus Article # as soon as content is generated.
texte.Ni l'annexe I ni l'annexe II. Une entrep: Neither Annex I nor Annex II. A construction company is not an essential or important entity on that account — it may be through another of its activities, never through this one.
texte.Ni l’un ni l’autre : les ranger avec les: Neither one nor the other: filing them with the gaps would accuse without knowing, filing them with the normal ones would make the estate look cleaner than it is.
